units.source_text: 宇治山庄中，收到了薰中纳言隆重的贺仪，但直到夜深还不见匂亲王来临，只收到他一封信。

en.t: At the Uji villa, they received splendid congratulatory gifts from Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, but Prince Niou still had not arrived late into the night, and only a letter from him came.

units.source_text: 大女公子想道：“果然不出所料！”不胜伤心。

en.t: The elder lady thought, “It is just as I expected,” and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 将近夜半，凄厉的秋风中飘来一阵芬芳的香气，英姿焕发的匂亲王果然光临了。

en.t: Near midnight, a fragrant scent drifted in on the piercing autumn wind, and Prince Niou, radiant and gallant, finally arrived.

units.source_text: 山庄中的人这一欢喜非同小可。

en.t: The people at the villa were overjoyed beyond measure.

units.source_text: 二女公子本人也深感匂亲王的诚意，态度稍稍柔顺些了。

en.t: The younger lady herself also deeply felt Prince Niou’s sincerity, and her manner softened a little.

units.source_text: 她正当青春盛年，容颜十分娇艳。

en.t: She was in the full bloom of youth, and her face was exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 今夜艳妆盛饰，其美丽越发无比。

en.t: Tonight, richly dressed and beautifully adorned, her loveliness seemed even more incomparable.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看见过许许多多美人，也觉得此人实在生得不坏，自容貌以至一切姿态，近看时越发标致。

en.t: Prince Niou had seen countless beauties, yet he felt that she was truly admirable; from her features to every movement, she appeared all the more charming when seen up close.

units.source_text: 山乡的老侍女们都张开了嘴，显出丑陋的笑颜，相与告道：“我家这位花朵一般的小姐，如果嫁了一个庸庸碌碌的男子，多么可惜啊！

en.t: The old serving women from the mountain village all opened their mouths in ungainly smiles and said to one another, “What a pity it would have been if our flower-like young lady had married some ordinary, unimpressive man!

units.source_text: 如今这段姻缘真是宿世修来的。”

en.t: This marriage bond must truly be the result of merit cultivated in a former life.”

units.source_text: 她们又私下讥评大女公子性情怪僻，认为不应该拒绝薰中纳言的求爱。

en.t: They also privately criticized the elder lady for her eccentric nature, thinking that she should not have rejected Kaoru’s courtship.

units.source_text: 这些侍女都过了盛年，把薰中纳言所赠华丽织物制成衣衫，穿在身上，甚不相称。

en.t: These serving women were all past their prime, and when they made garments from the gorgeous fabrics Kaoru had given and wore them, the clothes suited them very badly.

units.source_text: 无论何人看了，都觉得不成体统。

en.t: Anyone who saw them would have found it improper and undignified.

units.source_text: 大女公子看看她们，想道：“我身也已过却盛年，揽镜自视，容颜日见消瘦。

en.t: The elder lady looked at them and thought, “I too have already passed my prime; when I take up a mirror and look at myself, my face seems thinner day by day.

units.source_text: 这些侍女穿了不相称的衣服，没有一人认为自己难看。

en.t: These women wear clothes that do not suit them, yet not one of them thinks she looks unsightly.

units.source_text: 她们不顾自己发端稀疏，只管梳理额发，涂脂抹粉，沾沾自喜。

en.t: They pay no mind to their thinning hair, but fuss over their forelocks, put on rouge and powder, and feel pleased with themselves.

units.source_text: 我还没有像她们一样老丑，自以为眉清目秀，恐怕也是由于偏袒自己之故吧。”

en.t: I tell myself that I am not yet as old and ugly as they are, and that my features are still clear and pleasing, but perhaps that is only because I favor myself.”

units.source_text: 她看看这些侍女，怀着忧伤的心情躺下了。

en.t: She looked at the serving women and lay down with a sorrowful heart.

units.source_text: 接着又想：“照这模样，我更无面目会见俊美的男子。

en.t: Then she thought again, “In this state, I have even less face to meet a handsome man.

units.source_text: 自今再过一二年，衰瘦势必更甚。

en.t: After another year or two from now, my decline and thinness will surely grow still worse.

units.source_text: 女子的生涯真无常啊！”

en.t: A woman’s life is truly fleeting and uncertain!”

units.source_text: 她伸出细弱可怜的纤手来端详一下，继续思量人世之事。

en.t: She stretched out her delicate, pitifully slender hand and examined it for a while, then continued pondering the affairs of this world.
